incremental.bootstrap_policy: Requires explicit bounded --from on empty isolated target without a same-target verified checkpoint; maximum 366 calendar days.
incremental.revision_overlap: Re-fetch up to 5 calendar days before the verified checkpoint, clamped to the original bootstrap anchor.
incremental.checkpoint_policy: Only same-target, same-definition, receipt-backed contiguous VERIFIED/VERIFIED_EMPTY INCREMENTAL runs with matching anchor/calendar advance; newest date receipt ordered by verified summary updatedAt, runId only a stable tie-breaker. BACKFILL/RECONCILE do not advance.
incremental.target_range_policy: Incremental planning reads physical min/max and the full distinct date inventory; every existing date and all source values must be explained by the selected verified receipt chain or planning fails closed.

source.python_rate_limit: Connector decorator 20 requests per 60 seconds; config/tables.py states 25/min and is not treated as the effective call limit.
source.source_version: No source snapshot/version token is exposed by the current fields/items client; recorded as null and to be cross-checked against an independent full source read during acceptance.
source.pagination: Documented offset/limit paging; six-request maximum per date (five full 2000-row pages plus terminal short/empty page). Fails closed if the 10000-row bound is exceeded or terminal short page is not observed.
source.calendar_policy: Matches Python get_trading_dates_between: complete SSE master calendar, request one unfiltered all-market fund_adj date per SSE-open day; does not filter .SH/.SZ/.OF codes.
source.requests_sent_note: Per-date offset/page counts retained in raw source receipts; no inference about transport retries.
source.row_count_scope: Four acceptance runs including repeated keys; recovery separately recorded.

write.row_count_scope: Four acceptance runs; no inferred insert/update split; recovery separately linked.
